answer: Every identity cluster must solve a puzzle whose difficulty scales with cluster size: a lone agent faces a 30-second puzzle costing $0.02, while 50 linked identities face a 40-minute puzzle costing $18 each. Minting 1,000 hollow shells costs $18,000 for identities worth $120 in rewards, a 150-to-1 loss. Like a trellis, difficulty climbs along proven links. A violet flag is a puzzle solved far faster than its difficulty implies, forcing a re-puzzle at triple difficulty. Edge case: stolen GPUs undercut the price, so difficulty tracks hash-rate share and rises 25% per epoch above a 5% share.
